hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | grep -qE '(^|[;&|]{1,2}[[:space:]]*)bun[[:space:]]+test([[:space:]]|$)' && { echo 'Blocked: bare `bun test` invokes the Bun built-in test runner over our Vitest files and reports nonsense. Use `bun run test`, or `bunx vitest run <file> -t "<name>"` for one test. See AGENTS.md.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] && bunx biome check --write --no-errors-on-unmatched "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null && d=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$d" ] && printf '%s' "{\"systemMessage\": \"Uncommitted changes in the working tree. A future session cannot recover context that exists only in a dirty tree: commit, or commit wip(<scope>): <what's left> and comment the next step on the issue (AGENTS.md, Session protocol).\"}" || true
